items.title: Roger Kellaway interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 14, 1999
items.q: The name 'Monk' refers to the interviewer, Monk Rowe, not the jazz pianist Thelonious Monk. No mention of Thelonious Monk is present in the transcript.

ctx.x: My name is Monk Rowe and we are filming in Los Angeles for the Hamilton College Jazz Archive. It’s a real pleasure for me to have one of my favorite piano players and writers, Roger Kellaway.
